horoscope: Your confidence and positive attitude can help you get through several things today. The Moon in Taurus may encourage you to learn something new and look at things from a wider perspective. Try bringing back the excitement in your love life. Express your mind clearly, but don't forget to respect how others feel.
love: Under the Moon’s influence, you may get hurt emotionally by someone special’s behaviour. If someone is not taking your emotions seriously, talk about it clearly. Astrotalk’s astrologer advises you to give time to your relationship without compromising your self-respect.
finance: Today your financial condition will improve through your hard work. Mercury’s influence indicates a new source of income and profit from previous hard work. However, it’s not good for you to be financially dependent on others. Our astrologers advise you to gather information on your own in financial matters.
career: With the influence of Jupiter, you may feel more hopeful about new opportunities and changes at work today. If you have been waiting for a new project or more responsibility, this could be a good time to step forward and ask for it. Astrotalk's astrologers suggest trusting your plans and taking practical steps towards them.
health: If you don’t like regular exercise, then give it a try with swimming, dancing and Zumba. Choosing your own things will help you to be consistent with your routine. The moon influences you to perform your favourite activities. Astrotalk’s astrologers advise you to adopt new activities gradually and take care of your convenience.
